in_hebrew.name: Jody
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jody הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Jody is an English name derived from the Old English word 'gifa' meaning 'gift'. It was a common name for both boys and girls in the Middle Ages, but today is predominantly used for girls. The name is a reminder of the blessings and gifts that come from God.
